pages.text: $(#FF69B4)🌊 Coral Sanctuary · Miracle of Regeneration 🦈$()$(br2)$(l)$(#9370DB)「Those who drink this tide-infused essence shall receive the Breath of the Mermaid and the Body of Coral」$()$(br)The agility of $(#FF8C00)clownfish$(), the resilience of $(#228B22)deep-sea kelp$(), the sweetness of $(#DAA520)sunlight nectar$(), and the soothing power of $(#BA55D3)lavender$() blend together in the $(#00BFFF)Tidal Mortar$()—an ancient fisherman's secret to granting $(l)flesh the regenerative power of the ocean$().

$(#9370DB)▌ Dual Blessings of the Tide $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)💖 Coral Healing$()$(br)Wounds develop $(#FF1493)pink coral patterns$() and heal over time.$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)🧜 Breath of the Mermaid$()$(br)Automatically generates $(#00CED1)bubble coral$() underwater, supplying oxygen.

$(br2)$(#228B22)▌ Ancient Maritime Recipe $()$(br)- Soak $(#FF8C00)clownfish$() and $(#BA55D3)lavender$() in $(#00BFFF)moonlit seawater$() for $(#9370DB)three days and nights$().$(br)- $(#228B22)Kelp$() must be cured in $(#DAA520)honey$() until it develops $(#32CD32)emerald veins$().$(br)- Stir with a $(#483D8B)conch shell rod$(), following the $(#FF69B4)rhythm of the tide$().$(br2)$(#7FFFD4)※$() If successful, the liquid will reveal $(#FF1493)axolotl illusions$() and $(#00BFFF)whirlpool patterns$().

$(br2)$(#483D8B)『 Shipwreck Journal 』$()$(br)A record found inside a drifting bottle:$(br)'After drinking this $(#9370DB)liquid coral$(),$(br)I could breathe underwater $(#00BFFF)as easily as on land$(),$(br)and my $(#FF69B4)wounds$() healed $(#32CD32)visibly before my eyes$()—$(br)but beware of $(#228B22)fish swimming against the tide$() on $(#FF8C00)full moon nights$().$(br)That is the sign that the $(#BA55D3)ocean’s blessing$() is about to $(#00CED1)fade away$().'
